document.name: Master Circular on Health Insurance Business

rules.name: 60-Month Moratorium
rules.description: A policy and claim cannot be contested on grounds of non-disclosure or misrepresentation after 60 months of continuous coverage, except established fraud.

rules.name: Cashless Pre-Authorization
rules.description: Cashless authorization requests must be decided immediately and within one hour of receipt.

rules.name: Final Discharge Authorization
rules.description: Final discharge authorization must be granted within three hours of receiving the hospital's request.

rules.name: Claim Repudiation Approval
rules.description: No claim shall be repudiated without approval of the Product Management Committee or its three-member Claims Review Committee.

rules.name: Reasoned Claim Repudiation
rules.description: The insurer must communicate full details of repudiation or partial disallowance with references to specific policy terms.
